audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was marked Karma's stage, and no cooldowns appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Mantra needs no skill point and is available from level 1 on a 40s cooldown, shortened further by her damaging abilities — so Karma has no level-6 spike at all, while you gain the Armor/MR steroid and the third-strike damage. The page's own whys[4] already says "every all-in here is a kill". Focused Resolve is 12s at every rank, which is the only timer that gates your commits.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flipped to Jax with the Mantra-from-level-1 reason, and the 12s root plus 40s Mantra written into the cooldown block and Key Ability Interactions.

audit.why: The decisive interactions are already stated correctly and I left them: Focused Resolve is a tether that only roots if it is not broken, so leaving range or line of sight cancels it, and Inspire is a shield with move speed, not a disengage that stops your leap. Counter Strike's dodge is correctly used against her autos rather than against Inner Flame.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 read Karma at 3/10, and the page described a 58.22% Jax-favoured lane as diff FAV but difficulty 7.5/10 with a "Tricky matchup" final line.
audit.why: The packet chart is Karma/Skill/Jax/Jax/Jax/Jax/Jax — you own every stage from level 3 on. Difficulty 7.5/10 and an orange tone describe a lane you are losing, which contradicts both the win rate and the diff token already on the page.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flipped to Jax in both layers, difficulty brought to 4/10, and the tone and final-rating line aligned with the FAV token.

edits.before: Auto-trade only with E held in your pocket. Identify how Karma contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Only Leap Strike and no dodge yet, so Inner Flame pokes you for free from 950 range. Last-hit and refuse the trade.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Karma's Focused Resolve is down.
edits.after: Take Empower: the Leap Strike landing hit answers her poke, but only while Focused Resolve (12s) is spent.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Counter Strike online: leap in, dodge her auto on E, then recast — the stun bursts her through one Inspire shield.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Focused Resolve's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: You out-trade her whenever Focused Resolve (12s at every rank) is spent — one Inspire shield cannot refund your Empowered combo.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your R lands the Armor and MR steroid while her Mantra only empowers a spell she already had — every all-in here is a kill.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Focused Resolve's cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force ramps your on-hit faster than her enchanter items — force the fight the moment it completes.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — 12s at every rank, and the tether breaks if you leave range or line of sight. - Mantra: 40s, and she has it from level 1, so there is no dry level 6. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Karma's Focused Resolve: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. When it is down — E-counter his KA, Q-W burst.
edits.after: Track Focused Resolve (12s): the root tether breaks if you leave range or line of sight. Once spent — E her autos, Q-W burst.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Focused Resolve and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Focused Resolve and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Karma carry threat 6/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Karma carry threat 6/10.

notes: The substantive find: Mantra needs no skill point and is up from level 1 on 40s, so Karma has no level-6 spike — the chart gave her that row at 3/10 while the page's own whys[4] said every all-in at 6 is a kill for you. Flipped, and the reason is now on the page. Difficulty was also incoherent: diff FAV on a 58.22% lane sitting next to 7.5/10, an orange tone and a "Tricky matchup" final line; all three now say the same thing. The packet's four suspectNames are false positives — Focused Resolve and Counter Strike are spelled correctly on disk. No mirror exists for karma__jax yet; when it is written the chart must restate as Karma at Level 1, Skill at Level 2, Jax from Level 3 on.
